thread:
SRE-Bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 latency spike + 5xx rate increase for /v1/infer detected 14:05Z after deploy 2026-03-15. p95 -> 1.2s, p99 -> 8.7s, 5xx rate ~18% over baseline. tagging oncall
Eva (oncall): seeing it, joining. getting console now
Mike: rollback queued? which release id?
Eva (oncall): deploy id 2026-03-15-1627 (canary -> prod). rollbacks allowed for this release.
DeployBot: rollback started for release 2026-03-15-1627 -> initiator: Eva (oncall). ETA ~ 90s.
Nora: what customer impact? any major tenants affected? CS-Alerts: preliminary: ~2.1% of active requests are errors causing user-visible failures; some vendor integrations reporting timeouts.
Mike: checking runtime traces — looks like KV-cache miss storms and longer EV cache lookup times. extra tail on connection queue.
EngRuntime: seeing increased queue_wait for grpc workers, correlation with multiplexing batch size spike after release. sending config revert: set MAX_BATCH=32 -> 8
Eva (oncall): applied batch-size override via runtime flag. change rolled to canary and prod control plane. monitoring
SRE-Bot: metric update (14:08Z): p95 0.9s -> improved, p99 still ~6s, 5xx down to 9%
Mike: still some gateway 504s. tracing shows single node in pool hitting garbage-collection pauses + socket backlog. recommending node restart + route shift.
Eva (oncall): booting restart of problematic node pool id gpu-pool-7. running: kubectl rollout restart deploy/gpu-pool-7 -n rby-runtime
Eva (oncall): also shifting 10% traffic to fallback-model (smaller, quantized) via routing policy to reduce pressure.
DeployBot: rollback completed at 14:09:35Z. traffic rolled back to previous model binary.
SRE-Bot: post-rollback metric snapshot (14:10Z): p95 0.35s, p99 0.8s, 5xx ~0.4% — baseline restored.
Nora: handing off to EngRuntime for root-cause and postmortem. Eva (oncall) clear to demobilize once runbook steps assigned.
EngRuntime: grabbing logs and full trace set. creating ticket RINF-2654. initial hypothesis: regression in multiplex scheduling + cache eviction threshold that increased stall windows under high-concurrency paths.
Mike: snippets from problematic host (14:05:12):
```
E 14:05:12 kernel: tcp_recv: socket backlog overflow
W 14:05:12 runtime: kv_cache: eviction spike, evicted 820 keys in 1s
I 14:05:13 model_server: batch scheduler waiting 18s for batch completion
```
Eva (oncall): adding followups: 1) rollback verification + rollback playbook notes, 2) add automated canary guard on p99>2s, 3) add KV eviction alerts at shorter windows, 4) postmortem owner = EngRuntime.
CS-Alerts: notifying top 10 customers about transient errors and rollback. template message queued.
Nora: status check — anything left to do for live mitigation?
Mike: ensure the node restart finished and no stragglers. I see one host still on older kernel causing slow socket close; draining it now.
Eva (oncall): drain command: `kubectl drain host-rt-07 --ignore-daemonsets --force` done.
SRE-Bot: all mitigation steps complete at 14:12Z. assigning postmortem task RINF-2654 to EngRuntime; incident severity = P2, customer-impact window ~ 00:07:00.
EngRuntime: will reproduce in staging with same scheduling flags and KV thresholds. ETA initial RCA draft by EOD.
Eva (oncall): thanks team. closing on-call ops. please add any evidence to the ticket. :thumbsup:
Mike: leaving a note in deploy docs: block deploys that change multiplex scheduler without canary p99 gating.
Nora: I'll schedule a follow-up sync with CS + Product tomorrow AM to review communication and SLA exposure.
CS-Alerts: sent customer notifications at 14:18Z. will attach to RINF-2654.
SRE-Bot: incident thread archived.
